title: Low-bit compression profiles for ranking model with slice-aware NDCG/MRR audit
creator: Asha Patel
description: Define, calibrate, and validate low-bit (FP8/INT8) compression profiles for the production reranker model with an emphasis on slice-consistent ranking metrics. Deliver a calibration workflow that produces per-profile artifacts and an automated audit that reports NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR breakdowns across traffic slices (query difficulty, user cohort, document length). This ticket covers profiling design, calibration harness changes, and runway for a shadow rollout gating rule.
acceptance_criteria: Produce at least three distinct compression profiles: fp8-layerwise, int8-global, and hybrid-perblock, each with calibration artifacts (scale/zero-point or FP8 exponent tables) stored in model-registry.
Calibration workflow runs end-to-end in CI for a representative 50k query sample and outputs slice-level metrics (NDCG@10, NDCG@3, NDCG@1, MRR) and per-layer activation distribution deltas.
Define pass/fail gating: no slice should regress more than 0.5% absolute NDCG@10 or 1.0% relative MRR compared to baseline float32; documented rollback thresholds exist.
Create a lightweight 'slice-regression' dashboard panel in Console dev workspace that displays daily drift for the three profiles across top 6 slices.
Provide an operator runbook: how to run calibration locally, interpret artifacts, and perform a shadow deploy with automatic fallback to float32 when slice regressions exceed thresholds.
Deliver a short comparison report (PDF) with Monte Carlo stability results (10 seeds) and recommended default profile for Dedicated vs Hosted tiers.
work_items: Design per-layer scaling strategy and hybrid rounding rules (quant scheme doc).
Extend calibration harness to accept stratified sampling by slice key and emit per-slice metrics CSVs.
Implement FP8 exponent table generation and INT8 histogram-based symmetric/asymmetric calibration modes.
Integrate artifacts upload to model-registry with metadata: profile-name, seed, sample-size, commit-hash.
Add unit+integration tests for serialization/deserialization of calibration artifacts.
Implement Console dashboard telemetry wire-up and slice label mapping.
Run 10x Monte Carlo calibration runs on staging and collect stability statistics.
Draft shadow-rollout policy and rollback automation playbook for Canary and Dedicated deployments.
decisions: Use per-layer dynamic scaling for FP8 to reduce mantissa saturation on attention layers; agreed to use exponent biasing described in design doc.
Use asymmetric INT8 for embedding projections and symmetric INT8 for attention matmuls after microbenching latency vs accuracy trade-offs.
Calibration sample will be stratified by query difficulty decile and user_cohort to expose worst-case slices rather than global averages.
Gating thresholds set conservatively initially (0.5% absolute NDCG@10) and will be relaxed after two weeks of production shadow telemetry with manual review.
test_plan: Unit tests: quant math utilities, FP8 table compute, INT8 histogram binning.
Integration: run calibration harness against 50k sample and validate artifacts uploaded to model-registry.
Regression: compute NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR on golden validation set and compare to float32 baseline across slices.
Stability: Monte Carlo 10 seeds, report mean/std of slice-wise NDCG and MRR.
Performance: measure 99th percentile token latency and end-to-end latency change when using hybrid profile on a Dedicated GPU pool.
notes: Avoid reusing previous 'calib' binary; new harness uses modular io that matches model-registry URIs.
We should prioritize the hybrid-perblock profile for Dedicated customers because it offers better latency/accuracy tradeoff in microbenchmarks.
Edge case: very long documents (>=2048 tokens) show asymmetric degradation in NDCG@1; add a guard in serving to force float32 for these requests until further investigation.
Follow-up ticket recommended to automate threshold tuning using production shadow telemetry and Bayesian optimization.
